includes: openclaw plugins and every subcommand, including init, build and validate for authoring: this area's operations
every plugins.* Gateway method and plugin.approval.* method: this area's entry points; plugins.uiDescriptors and plugins.sessionAction are plugin calls into this area

the Plugins hub at /plugins, Settings → Plugins at /settings/plugins, a plugin's overview, settings editor, consent dialog, install progress and MCP login, and plugin pages under ui/src/pages/plugin: this area's UI actions
plugin pages, widgets, actions and view replacements from feature plugins (docs/plugins/feature-plugins.md), and plugins.controlUi.*: this area's operations

loading plugins at Gateway startup, auto-enable, discovery of bundled and external plugins, hot reload and replacement with recovery, and source capture of non-bundled plugins: this area's conditions and operations

native-format bundles (Codex, Claude, Cursor) installed as plugins, and native Codex plugins configured for Codex-mode agents (docs/plugins/codex-native-plugins.md), including app authority capture: this area's operations
plugin permission requests and plugin tool-call approvals (docs/plugins/plugin-permission-requests.md): this area's operation

the plugin SDK contract: each api.register* registration method and each typed hook name in docs/plugins/hooks/reference.md counts once as an entry point of kind plugin call; the place in another area that invokes the hook is not counted again
plugins.skills.read and a plugin's bundled skill preview on its overview: this area's operation
hook packs installed through openclaw plugins install: this area's install operation
setup-time plugin installs from onboarding and the Codex runtime install: entry points of kind from <area>; the area's install operation they reach is listed, their own code is not
extensions/**: every shipped plugin is installed, enabled, disabled, loaded at startup and reloaded through this area's operations; changes there select this template's lifecycle phases

runtime and deployment variants the documents describe (the Bun runtime, the Docker image with a bundled source overlay, plugins built on the host of a source checkout, maintainer install overrides set through environment variables): conditions of this area, each outside this template's reach because the persona runs a released npm build on Node with no override environment; they are listed and reported uncovered, never dropped

UI actions: a control counts when a page module under this area's paths renders it or a listed document names it; a label that exists only in a locale file and is rendered by no page module is not an entry point

search scope: each symbol and literal under search is matched as a fixed string with git grep at the revision over src, ui/src, apps and packages, leaving out test files (*.test.*, *.spec.*, *test-support*, *test-helpers*, *mocks*, *fixture*, any path segment test, tests or Tests) and every path inside this area's globs (extensions/** is inside them); each file found is one entry point of kind from <area>

HTTP routes served from this area's Gateway files are entry points of kind route, one per path: /__openclaw__/catalog-icon, /__openclaw__/link-favicon, /__openclaw__/plugin-icon, /__openclaw__/plugin-activity-icon and /__openclaw__/plugin-theme-art (src/gateway/plugin-icon-http.ts, src/gateway/plugin-theme-art-http.ts), the native plugin UI asset route (src/gateway/control-ui-plugin-assets.ts) and the plugin tab auth cookie grant (src/gateway/control-ui-plugin-auth-cookie.ts, src/gateway/server-http-plugin-auth.ts)

each api.register* method counts once, under the flat name docs/plugins/sdk-overview.md lists; a namespaced form (api.session.controls.*, api.session.state.*, api.session.workflow.*, api.agent.events.*, api.lifecycle.*) and a deprecated alias of it are the same entry point
excludes: a plugin's own feature behaviour once loaded (docs/plugins/reference/*, voice-call, meetings, memory plugins, workboard, logbook and the other per-plugin documents): owned by that plugin's feature area
channel plugin messaging, channel setup and login, channels.* methods, openclaw channels, docs/plugins/sdk-channel-*: owned by channels; installing, enabling and loading a channel plugin stays here

config.get, config.set, config.patch, config.apply, openclaw config and general config hot reload: owned by config; plugins.entries.<id>.config written through a plugin's settings editor or plugins commands stays here

openclaw update and its plugin convergence, Doctor and its plugin repairs (src/commands/doctor-plugin-*.ts, src/commands/doctor-config-preflight-plugin-*.ts), deferred plugin migrations (src/infra/deferred-plugin-*.ts): owned by update; Doctor's plugin repair is listed as an entry point of kind from update
sessions.* methods and docs/plugins/hooks/prompt-and-session.md session semantics: owned by sessions; the hook names themselves are counted here
skills.*, openclaw skills, the Skills and Skill workshop pages: owned by skills
model provider behaviour, model catalogs and provider auth (docs/plugins/sdk-provider-plugins*, docs/plugins/manifest/*): owned by models; installing and enabling a provider plugin stays here
the Codex, Copilot and Agents API harnesses (docs/plugins/codex-harness*, copilot, agentsapi, sdk-agent-harness): owned by agent runtime
api.runtime.* helpers (docs/plugins/sdk-runtime*): consumed from the area each helper wraps
openclaw hooks, internal hooks and webhooks: owned by automation
the MCP settings page and mcp config: owned by MCP; MCP servers a plugin bundles stay here
Windows-only path handling: owned by platform; a break that needs Windows is outside this template's reach
